cells.title: Hold out a fixed tenth of cells from the learned-context block
cells.action: Follow the Contract for kom-1 in docs/history/knowledge-outcome-measure/plan.md. Kind cell dispatches get a deterministic arm: holdout when the first 8 hex digits of sha256_hex(cell id) as u32 mod 100 is below .bee/config.json knowledge_holdout_percent (absent or invalid = 10, integer 0..=100 honored, 0 = off). Holdout renders no Learned context block; knowledge arm prompt stays byte-identical. The kind cell prepare record gains knowledge_arm and learned_context (array of listed repo-relative paths, [] when none). Other kinds' records stay byte-identical. Write the tests first and watch them fail.

truths: A holdout cell brief carries no Learned context block
A knowledge-arm cell brief is byte-identical to before
The same cell id always lands in the same arm
knowledge_holdout_percent 0 holds out no cell; absent or invalid uses 10
The kind cell dispatch record carries knowledge_arm and learned_context; other kinds carry neither

cells.title: Compare holdout and knowledge cells in the knowledge report
cells.action: Follow the Contract for kom-2 in docs/history/knowledge-outcome-measure/plan.md. bee knowledge report keeps measured, unmeasured and the evidence ladder and gains outcomes: per arm (knowledge, holdout) the counts cells, blocked, reopened, red_rounds, with_mistakes plus rates (3 decimals), unrecorded, min_per_arm 30 and comparable. Population: capped or dropped cells under .bee/cells (archive included). Arm: knowledge_arm on the earliest dispatch.jsonl row with source prepare, kind cell and that cell id; none means unrecorded. Signals from trace: blocked_reason non-empty string, reopened_for_rework or reopened_at non-null, attempts non-empty, mistakes non-empty. Missing files or bad rows are skipped. Text output adds one line per arm and a too-few line when not comparable. Write the tests first and watch them fail.

truths: bee knowledge report JSON carries outcomes with per-arm counts and rates
A cell with no recorded arm counts as unrecorded and in neither arm
Open cells are excluded from the population
comparable is false until both arms reach 30 cells
measured, unmeasured and the evidence ladder are unchanged

cells.title: Document the holdout and the outcomes measure
cells.action: Follow the Contract for kom-3 in docs/history/knowledge-outcome-measure/plan.md. Update the help text for bee dispatch prepare (holdout arm, knowledge_holdout_percent, the knowledge_arm and learned_context record keys) and bee knowledge report (the outcomes section) in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/generated/registry_payload.json, the help text's one home, keeping it valid JSON. Add the holdout behavior to docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/dispatch.md and the outcomes measure to docs/knowledge/areas/okf-profile/critical-bar.md, stating the signature count is not the usefulness measure. Cite plan D1-D5, never raw decision ids.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test registry_contracts && .bee/bin/bee knowledge check

truths: bee dispatch prepare --help names the holdout and knowledge_holdout_percent
bee knowledge report --help names the outcomes section
The knowledge docs describe the holdout and the outcomes measure citing plan D-numbers
